description.value: Hotel Belleclaire sits at 2175 Broadway on the Upper West Side. The hotel lists a 24-hour fitness center, walking tours, wine hours, and dog-friendly stays among its amenities. It puts guests close to the subway, Zabar's and the park for an easy uptown base.
